frozen_before: any monthly return of ranks 1001-3000 is computed; only file shapes and date ranges of the cached monthly bars were inspected
hypothesis: Among liquid small caps (point-in-time dollar-volume ranks 1001-3000), last month's biggest losers beat the equal-weight small-cap basket the next month by more than a 50 bps round trip. Long-only, so it is executable on Alpaca with market-on-close orders and no borrow.

inputs.monthly_bars: log/2026-10-12/init7-reversal20-pit/monthly.json.gz (Alpaca SIP 1Month bars, adjustment=all, 2016-01 to 2025-09, 7,262 symbols including inactive)
inputs.universe_list: log/2026-10-12/init7-reversal20-pit/universe.json.gz key alpaca (funds already removed by name)

universe.symbols: universe.alpaca, minus 5-letter symbols ending in U, W or R (units, warrants, rights), minus symbols containing '.'
universe.duplicates: same rule as init7-reversal20-pit: a monthly bar with the same (month, volume) as a longer-history symbol is dropped
universe.ranking: sum of monthly vwap x volume over months m-3, m-2, m-1 for decision month m; names need bars in all three months

portfolio: long the 10% of eligible names with the lowest r_prev (ties by symbol), equal weight, entered at the close of month m-1, exited at the close of month m
benchmark: equal-weight return of all eligible names over the same month
missing_exit: a name with no bar in month m (delisted or halted) gets -30% (Shumway's performance-delisting proxy); applied to portfolio and benchmark alike

cost.applied_to: portfolio only, full turnover assumed every month

unit: monthly excess = portfolio return - benchmark return - cost

pass.bootstrap_95_lower_gt_0: iid resampling of months, 4000 draws, seed 13, 2.5% bound of the mean excess

descriptive_only: raw long return and QQQ-free cash comparison (absolute dollars per month per $100k)
long-short spread (bottom minus top decile), not executable for HTB names
missing-exit count and sensitivity with missing exits dropped
decision_if_pass: fetch adjusted monthly bars for 2025-07 to 2026-09 and repeat on 2025-10 to 2026-09 as a holdout before any shadow pilot; any live use goes to Juan
decision_if_fail: drop small-cap monthly reversal; next candidate is post-earnings drift in ranks 1001-3000 with SEC 8-K item 2.02 dates
